criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame carries a drawn subject at true scale, graded, one screen throughout, and frames 3, 5, 7 and 2 are genuinely good. Against it, frames 1, 6, 8 and 9 give 40 to 55 percent of the canvas to a graded empty field. Frame 9's declared pickup is an unreadable fragment bleeding the right edge and that frame's own acceptance item is not met. On frame 5 the apron reads as one uniform diagonal hatch edge to edge and I cannot resolve the three per-building casts the run reports as visible. Detail is budgeted where the frame starts, not where the argument lands.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: The deck's strongest structural work. One light, one ground, one screen, one palette, and comal discipline actually held: five frames inside the declared band and never over half a percent. The 7/8 camera pair is real and the figure sits within about 10px of the same mark in both renders. Nothing strobes. But one of three declared continuity devices was not printed and the storyboard says so in its own capitals. The deck bought halftone over stipple by arithmetic for an arc it never rendered, and paid for it in a 61.77 MB PDF.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: I tried to refute this and mostly could not. Every numeral on all nine frames and in the caption traces, and I re-derived Three bodies by hand from compute.py and it is correct. Both verbatim sentences on frame 3 are character for character. The three traps this story sets were all avoided. The first comment's 13 ids are exactly the union of the nine cite lines. Two live defects keep it off 9: frame 2's dek asserts 'The survey is the board's', which traces to c1 and not to the c12 c13 its footer prints, which is the exact inverse of the c14 miscite this run fixed on frame 8 and did not sweep; and frame 3's dossier calls the drawn page 'the Governor's directive' when the only document quoted is the press release.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A Texan learns exactly who decided, who must act, what the consequence is and three real dates in order. That is a clear, accurate story with a spine of dates. What holds it at 7 is the run's own texan_check line: nine frames name no Texas county, city or watershed, and the next step handed to the reader is a date on which a document may appear.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The 1-2-3 run is the deck's best movement and frame 3 is a real turn. The 7/8 beat is the sharpest idea in the deck and lands. Against that, frame 4 is still a detour the run itself lists as unfixed, its connective is in SELECTION.md and not on the frame, and cutting it costs the argument nothing.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: The hooks are short, declarative and human, and the caption opens and closes well. House rules hold. What is missing is any regional specificity at all. This reads as competent statewide institutional prose that would work unchanged for any state with a water board.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The world is genuinely new and the opening move was unspent. But this is the third data center deck in six days and the fourth in the window resting on an ERCOT market notice. Worse, SELECTION.md wrote its own constraint that no frame is about notarization or who files on whose behalf as its subject, and frame 5 breaks it outright. The instrument blind spot that six run records each flagged in capitals recurs here and dedupe_check still cannot see it.

class_sweep_incomplete: Frame 6's focal was reported rewritten and is unchanged. Frame 1's focal was repaired and its four siblings were not, in subject, value_structure, acceptance and risks. Frame 8 is now self-contradictory inside one dossier, saying in capitals that the building has no gable while its bands and acceptance still demand one. Two of three reported focal repairs landed, one did not, and seven sibling assertions of the same falsehood survive.
one_sentence_fix: Derive each dossier's named parts from the chassis's own draw calls instead of writing them in prose, because three rounds were spent repairing gables that were never drawn while the real defect, four frames giving 40 to 55 percent of the canvas to empty graded ground, went untouched from round 1 to the cap.
